subject: Startups
title: The Pivot Spectrum
description: A fast breakdown of The Pivot Spectrum for builders.

hook.text: Pivots aren't all the same size. Some are tiny tweaks—others are complete reinventions of the company.

buildup.text: A zoom-in pivot focuses on one feature that users love. A zoom-out pivot turns a feature into a full product.

discovery.text: There are at least ten types: customer segment, channel, revenue model, technology, and more.

twist.text: Most successful pivots are small. The founder changes one variable, not the whole equation.

climax.text: Understanding pivot types helps founders make precise moves instead of blowing everything up.

punchline.text: The best pivots change one thing, not everything.

quiz.question: What is a zoom-in pivot?
options: Focusing on one feature users love
